name: Rank number
what: A countdown item for a top-5 / top-10 video: 'TOP 5 EDITING TRICKS' on top, a huge outlined number slams in and fills with colour from the bottom, the item's title wipes in under it, a light streak crosses the number; it pushes out at the end.
origin: numbered list / countdown titles - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: kicker 10 f; number 2.2 -> 1 in 8 f (accelerating) + a 3 f shake; fill rises 14 f (S-curve); title 12 f behind a mask, small line 6 f later; streak 12 f; out 10 f
